name: Ortur Laser Master H10 10W
tagline: 10W Ortur's enclosed-style H-series: faster frame, tighter integration than LM3
tldr: Ortur Laser Master H10 10W is the 10W SKU on the Ortur ortur laser master h10 line. The H10 is Ortur's step up from the open-frame LM3 line: a more integrated chassis with up to 20W diode power and higher advertised traverse speeds. Verify optical power on the listing: do not assume combined-watt marketing.
mainObjective: High-quality hobby and light-business engraving with light, slow cutting

priceRange.note: 10W optical module: verify SKU before buying

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Lowest entry to the H10 frame: $359.99 basic set at Ortur in October 2026
Fine ~0.07 mm spot in our profile for text and line art
Same H10 frame and accessories, such as the ORP1.0 raiser, as the stronger module
cons: Slow cutting: a 3 mm basswood square takes ~14–24 min in our benchmarks
Photo fills run at only ~6–14 mm/s in our tests
No free air pump in the basic set, unlike Ortur's higher-power H10 offer
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 10W SKU on Ortur Laser Master H10. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other power options via the chips before buying.
proTips: Run material test grids at engraving speeds first. Add air assist for light cuts. If cut jobs exceed ~30% of your week, open the higher-watt profile on this site and compare times.

editorialDepth.advantages: Ortur Laser Master H10 10W suits makers who sell marks, photos, and gifts more than daily panel cutting. Reasonable open-frame entry price.
editorialDepth.limitations: Skip if you already quote 5 mm+ cutting in production: see 20W or 40W in the line. Not for cast acrylic or bare metal without spray.

faq.question: How much is the H10 10W compared with the 20W?
faq.answer: Ortur's own store sometimes undercuts our tracked range: in October 2026 it listed the H10 10W basic set at $359.99 ($389.99 with the ORP1.0 raiser, $449.99 with the LEP1.0 bundle), against $549.99–649.99 for the 20W basic set depending on the listing, the 20W coming with a free air pump.

faq.question: What can the H10 10W cut?
faq.answer: In our benchmarks a 10 × 10 cm square in 3 mm basswood takes about 14–24 min at 2–3 mm/s. Basswood up to about 5 mm and thin black acrylic are possible in several passes. Treat this module as an engraver that can cut thin stock, not as a cutting machine.

faq.question: H10 10W or 20W: which fits my use?
faq.answer: Pick the 10W if you mainly engrave text, logos and photos and want the lowest price. Pick the 20W if you cut: Ortur demonstrates 12 mm pine, 8 mm plywood and 8 mm black acrylic in one pass with its LU3-20B module, and our 3 mm benchmark drops to about 9–15 min.

standoutFeatures.title: H10 frame at the lowest price
standoutFeatures.body: The basic set was $359.99 on Ortur's store in October 2026, with the same frame as the costlier version.

standoutFeatures.title: Fine detail
standoutFeatures.body: About 0.07 mm spot in our profile, suited to small lettering, logos and line art.
